content: Indication-specific dosing for asafoetida includes the following: For gastrointestinal problems such as flatulence and dyspepsia, as well as for bronchitis, other respiratory issues, cancer, and influenza, the recommended dosage is 5-1 mL taken orally three times daily (TID). Efficacy data is limited to animal studies only. Adverse effects, though rare, may include gastrointestinal problems such as diarrhea, nausea, or vomiting. Other rare adverse effects include bleeding, swelling of the lips, convulsions, and headache. Special precautions should be taken during pregnancy, as asafoetida may have abortifacient properties. It is also contraindicated in individuals with bleeding disorders, epilepsy, or blood pressure abnormalities. In infants, asafoetida may be used for colic but may cause gastrointestinal upset. Asafoetida contains coumarin-like substances, which may increase the risk of bleeding if administered concurrently with anticoagulants. Pregnancy Category is not available (N/A), but it is advised to avoid use during pregnancy. Similarly, lactation safety data is not available (N/A). For general use, asafoetida is considered generally acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
